text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Monday at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Lithuanian Parliamentary Chairman Vytautas Landsbergis said that Lithuania is carrying out a very active foreign policy and that the presidential office plays an important role in this. Landsbergis said relations with Russia and Kaliningrad have improved. Landsbergis evaluated positively an initiative to organise a meeting of the presidents of the three Baltic states, Russia, Ukraine and Poland in the autumn. But he wondered whether an invitation to the president of Belarus might be interpreted as support for his policies.
